_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "experience" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "age" INTEGER NULL, "energy" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "onboarded" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("onboarded" IN (0, 1)), "last_review" TEXT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'barbell,dumbbell,machine,cable,bodyweight', "training_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '2,4,6', "session_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60, "setup_skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("setup_skipped" IN (0, 1)), "setup_step" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "hour" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23), "minute" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 59), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "feeling" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_kg" >= 0.0), "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("skipped" IN (0, 1)), "skip_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "exercise_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_overrides" ("date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "check_ins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "phase" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'before', "feeling" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("date_key", "phase"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("calories" >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_imports" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "override_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "check_in_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "food_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "accepted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_versions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "focus" TEXT NOT NULL, "warmup" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("plan_id", "weekday"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_routine_exercises" ("routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps_max" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rir" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "increment_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "reference_weight_kg" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("routine_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("number" >= 1), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL CHECK("weight_kg" >= 0.0), "reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("reps" >= 0), "rir" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rir" BETWEEN 0 AND 10), "skip_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "exercise_id", "position"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reschedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "undone_at" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_adjustments" ("date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("applied" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date_key"));
CREATE INDEX set_logs_exercise ON set_logs (session_id, exercise_id)
